adminNotifications.siteDescription: Site-wide account, group and administration alerts. Only site administrators on the server Discord ID allowlist can manage these settings.
adminNotifications.sitePrivate: Saved webhook URLs are never returned. A saved destination overrides the environment webhook; disabling it does not fall back to the environment.
adminNotifications.categoryHint: Categories are enabled by default. Disabling skips new and queued unsent alerts; deliveries already started may still arrive. Re-enabling does not replay skipped alerts. Optional role IDs must be 17–20 digits.
adminNotifications.accessDenied: Site administrator access is required. Sign in with an allowlisted Discord account.
adminNotifications.roleMentionsHint: Optional: paste one Discord role ID per type (enable Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click a role and Copy Role ID). Leave blank for no ping. The webhook must be allowed to mention that role.
adminNotifications.title: Private administration notifications
adminNotifications.description: Send membership, role, permission and Discord configuration changes to a private admin channel. Group deletion is also reported. New accounts and group creation/deletion use the site administrator webhook.
adminNotifications.webhook: New or replacement admin webhook URL
adminNotifications.private: Only group administrators can change this destination. Saved URLs are never returned to the browser. Use a private Discord channel; these alerts contain administrative information.
adminNotifications.failed: Unable to load or save admin notifications. Check administrator access, the webhook URL, role IDs and migrations 015–017, then refresh.

adminNotifications.delivery: Queued changes are processed every minute, five per batch. Only new changes are captured. Rate limits are retried up to five attempts; uncertain deliveries are not retried automatically. Check Discord before retrying. Some server-side changes have no identifiable actor. Removal alerts cannot distinguish leaving, removal or account deletion.
